reproduction.method: Exact finite Bayesian posterior, deterministic Hamming likelihood, posterior expected-improvement acquisition
reproduction.description: Infer a hidden three-symbol code through real oracle queries and display posterior contraction and the decoded code.
differences: 3 slots × 3 symbols with uniform prior replaces original default 2-slot hinted prior/debug prompt.
No cubic likelihood tensor: likelihood is computed on demand.
This is Hamming-code optimization, not text cryptanalysis.

metrics.acquisition: Exact posterior expected improvement; deterministic ties

checks.name: Every update preserves the true code in support
Decoded code exactly matches hidden code
